title: TRICARE Select Card Payment Amount - Fee Desk Calculation Note
content:
**The calculation.** A one-time card payment toward a fee-bearing **TRICARE Select** enrollment whose installments are quarterly or annual and whose elected payment method is a single card payment or a check is figured on the enrollment's latest installment, as follows.

1. **Enrollments covered.** It covers a fee-bearing enrollment (one carrying the family's fee billing) that took effect in the plan year that contains the payment date, whose elected payment method is a single card payment or a check and whose frequency in force is quarterly or annual, so that every installment whose coverage period has begun belongs to that plan year; for any other enrollment this calculation settles nothing.
2. **Standing of the enrollment.** An enrollment's standing is its lifecycle status: it has ended when its status is disenrolled voluntarily, disenrolled for nonpayment, terminated as ineligible or transferred out, whatever the payment date, and its last day of coverage is then the disenrollment date on its record; it is active when its status is active; and it is awaiting activation when its status is applied. A rejected enrollment owes no fee and is outside these rules.
3. **Frequency in force.** A change of installment frequency takes effect from the next installment period, so an installment is owed at the frequency in force, the one installments are being charged at: where an annual installment has been charged for a coverage period starting in the calendar year of the payment date, on or before that date, the frequency in force is annual; otherwise, where a quarterly installment has been charged for a coverage period starting in the calendar quarter of the payment date, on or before that date, it is quarterly; otherwise, where a monthly installment has been charged for a coverage period starting in the month of the payment date, on or before that date, it is monthly; and where none has been, it is the frequency the enrollment has elected. At the frequency in force an installment period is the calendar year for an annual installment and the calendar quarter for a quarterly one.
4. **The latest installment.** Where the enrollment has ended, the latest installment is the charges whose coverage period starts in the installment period (the calendar quarter for quarterly installments, the calendar year for annual ones) that contains the last day of coverage, no later than the month containing that day and no later than the payment date; otherwise it is the charges made for coverage periods starting in the installment period that contains the payment date, on or before that date.
5. **Installment owed.** The latest installment is owed at the tier's family annual fee for its whole period: one quarter of it (the annual fee divided by 4) for a quarterly installment, all of it for an annual one, rounded to the cent.
6. **Charges counted on the account.** The enrollment's first installment - the charge whose coverage period starts on the effective date - counts as a charge on the account.
7. **Card payment.** The installment owed plus the amount by which the charges counted, other than those of the latest installment, exceed the payments posted on the fee account (nothing where they do not), rounded to the cent and never below zero.

## Calendar conventions

Plan years are calendar years of 12 months and installment periods are calendar periods, reckoned on the calendar from 2000-01-01: quarters begin in January, April, July and October, and a monthly figure of the annual fee is one twelfth of it (divided by 12). The payment date is the date the card payment is made.

## Worked figures (hypothetical, TRICARE Select Retiree Group B, family annual fee 1190.16)

| Installments | Latest installment | Payments posted | Card payment |
|---|---|---|---|
| quarterly | the first installment, charged for the current quarter | 0.00 | 1190.16 divided by 4: 297.54 |
| annual | the first installment, charged for the current year | 0.00 | 1190.16 |

In each row the latest installment is the first installment itself, so no other counted charge stands beside it.
